GLANCE
======

Gaussian Latent Alignment via Neighbor Contrastive Encoding
--------------------------------------------------------------

Batch-aware integration and protein-level interpretation of single-cell
mass spectrometry and spatial proteomics data.

   :gutter: 2

   .. grid-item-card:: Installation
      :link: installation
      :link-type: doc

      Set up Python and install GLANCE with the tutorial dependencies.

   .. grid-item-card:: Tutorials
      :link: tutorials/index
      :link-type: doc

      Follow the repository's original notebooks from data preparation to
      integration and abundance score interpretation.
